## 3. Detailed Projects Showcase

### CaramelPepper (AI Coding Environment)
- **Role**: Creator & Lead Developer
- **Subtitle**: AI Coding Environment
- **Description**: An AI-powered coding environment combining modern web developer tooling with cloud and local LLM workflows. Incorporates a Monaco-based code editor, file workspace support, and AI-assisted code generation.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Firebase, Electron, Genkit, Monaco Editor
- **Links**:
  - Live Application: https://caramelpepper.vercel.app
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/NotBhan/caramelpepper

### ExamPrep AI (AI Study Platform)
- **Role**: Creator & Lead Developer
- **Subtitle**: AI Study Platform
- **Description**: An AI study assistant that ingests syllabi and produces structured learning materials, study timelines, topic breakdowns, practice quizzes, and an AI tutor for interactive Q&A.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Gemini API, Genkit
- **Links**:
  - Live Application: https://examprep-ai-five.vercel.app
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/NotBhan/examprep-ai

### StudentVoice (Campus Feedback Platform)
- **Role**: Team Lead (4-member team)
- **Subtitle**: Campus Feedback Platform
- **Description**: An anonymous student feedback platform connecting issue reporting with university administrative workflows and AI sentiment/topic analysis.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Gemini API, Genkit
- **Links**:
  - Live Application: https://student-voice-sigma.vercel.app
  - GitHub Repository: https://github.com/NotBhan/team-epicode--student-voice
